digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira adapter mapping seam
propositions: Rebar reconciler hardcodes Jira project mappings (status, type, priority, link relations, transitions, parent hierarchy) in three separate locations, forcing core edits to support projects with workflow variance.

Projects require per-axis mapping overrides (status, type, permissible transitions, parent relationships) plus sibling axes (link relations, priority) and create-field defaults, with no current mechanism to configure these without code changes.

A provider-neutral, layered config-driven mapping seam must be introduced in rebar.toml that preserves backward compatibility (built-in defaults matching current hardcoded behavior) while allowing per-project overlays.
Non-allowed transitions must be resolved by replaying rebar's recorded STATUS event log hops in order, with drift-and-warning as fallback for unmapped or compacted tickets.

Non-representable parent relationships must be recorded with echo-safe breadcrumb comments naming the nearest represented ancestor, and unmapped types must be collapsed (via rebar-type: labels) or skipped (whole-ticket) or fail-closed at config load.
